title: Prophecy Completed
label: ORG Music
description: Recorded live at New York’s Cellar Cafe on June 14, 1964, Prophecy captures Albert Ayler’s groundbreaking trio with Gary Peacock and Sunny Murray at a pivotal moment in the evolution of free jazz. Ferocious, spiritual, and deeply expressive, the performance introduced compositions like “Ghosts” and “Spirits” in some of their earliest recorded forms, documenting the raw intensity and emotional force that would define Ayler’s legacy. Prophecy Completed expands upon the original album with an additional LP featuring the complete performance for the first time in this format, presenting a fuller picture of this historic session. Newly remastered by Dave Gardner, this deluxe edition continues Org Music’s ongoing archival partnership with the Albert Ayler Estate and restores one of the essential documents of avant-garde jazz history.

title: Blue Moon Over Paris - ORTF Recordings 1963-1968
label: Elemental Music
description: Two never-before-released complete sets by the unforgettable Art Blakey’s Jazz Messengers are presented here. The first, recorded in 1963 at the iconic Olympia Theatre in Paris, features a stellar lineup: Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Cedar Walton on piano, Reggie Workman on bass, and the leader himself on drums. Highlights include an impressive arrangement of Henry Mancini’s “Moon River” and an extraordinary take on Duke Ellington’s “Caravan.” The second set, taped in 1968 at the equally renowned Salle Pleyel, also in Paris, finds Blakey joined by Bill Hardman on trumpet, Julian Priester on trombone, Billy Harper on tenor saxophone, Ronnie Mathews on piano, and Lawrence Evans on bass. Among the many highlights are an extended performance of the rarely heard “Blues for Eros” and a dazzling version of Bobby Timmons’ “Moanin’.” Transferred from the original tape reels preserved at INA and restored and mastered by Matthew Lutthans at The Mastering Lab, this limited-edition 180-gram 2-LP set includes an extensive insert featuring rare photographs and specially prepared liner notes.

title: Bewitching Bird: Bird At Café Society and The Sky Bar
label: Liberation Hall
description:
Two performances from the iconic saxophonist.

Side One features five tracks recorded in 1950 at the legendary Greenwich Village club Café Society. Featured on the set is a ten-minute medley of four standards with an all-star band --- trumpeter Kenny Dorham, pianist Al Haig, bassist Tommy Potter and drummer Roy Haynes. Two tracks are very rare cuts. Parker had never recorded ""I Cover The Waterfront"" and the version of ""Bewitched"" had never been officially released on any Bird album. The final track ""Lover, Come Back To Me"" was recorded on a different date with pianist Dick Hyman, guitarist Mundell Lowe, bassist Irv Lang and drummer Irv Kluger.

Side two contains ultra-rare, never-before-issued live tracks recorded in 1951 at Lindsay's Sky Bar in Cleveland, a venue from which few, if any, other tracks survived. Featuring drummer Roy Haynes, trombonist Jimmy Knepper, pianist Walter Bishop Jr. and bassist Teddy Kotick, they are the stuff that ornithologists’ ""dreams are made of""--not only for their rarity, but for their quality. This RSD Black Friday 2026 LP includes detailed liner notes and is mastered from the original tapes, pressed on 180g vinyl."

title: Happy Hollow (20 Year Anniversary Edition)
label: Run For Cover Records
description: HAPPY HOLLOW - one of Cursive’s most ambitious and acclaimed records - somehow turned 20 years old this year. To commemorate the anniversary, Cursive and Run For Cover have teamed up to deliver the definitive version of Happy Hollow, in record stores starting on RSD Black Friday 2026. This limited collector’s edition is pressed on three disc color vinyl and expands the world of Happy Hollow to three discs of demos, out-takes and b-sides from the album’s initial release. title: David Axelrod

description: 2001’s self-titled David Axelrod was originally issued on Mo’Wax and is long out of print on vinyl. The genesis of the full length is a “lost” album recorded in the late ‘60s, in the same period as his landmark release, Songs of Experience. It was meant to be an Electric Prunes album, the third of a trilogy for Reprise, based around the legend of Faust. He took his stalwart crew of LA session musicians, including drummer Earl Palmer, bassist Carol Kaye and guitarists Howard Roberts and Pete Wyant, and recorded rhythm tracks. He cut them to an acetate for review. The project was shelved, but he kept that acetate. In the late 90s, after meeting Mo’Wax boss James Lavelle through his work with DJ Shadow, Axelrod agreed to write, arrange and record what would have been the completed orchestra and horn tracks at the same Capitol Studios he had recorded at in the 1960s. He augmented the album with two tracks written specifically for the release, no longer about a cursed bargain, but as a reflection of a life in music, and a life, few knew then, full of triumph and tragedy. Now-Again’s Egon sat in on those Capitol sessions and, 26 years after their recording, has partnered with the Axelrod Estate to present this music anew.

description: • First time on vinyl. • Includes 4 bonus tracks, also making their vinyl debut. • Limited pressing on opaque red and green vinyl for RSD Black Friday. • New liner notes from Jason Without question, Jason Falkner stands among the most gifted musicians, songwriters, and producers in modern popular music. Beyond the acclaimed recordings he has made as a solo artist and with his influential bands—The Three O’Clock, Jellyfish, The Grays, and TV Eyes—Falkner’s extraordinary talents have been sought out by an impressive roster of artists including Beck, Paul McCartney, Aimee Mann, St. Vincent, Noel Gallagher, Brendan Benson, and Air. Born in San Francisco and raised in Southern California, Falkner was a classically trained piano prodigy whose musical gifts emerged at an early age. He first gained widespread recognition as a member of the pioneering Paisley Underground band The Three O’Clock, whose final album, Vermillion, was released on Prince’s Paisley Park Records. Soon afterward, he joined the legendary power-pop outfit Jellyfish before forming the highly influential pop-rock group The Grays alongside Jon Brion. Yet Falkner’s true artistic destiny lay in his solo work. In 1996, he signed with Elektra Records and released two critically celebrated albums: Presents Author Unknown and Can You Still Feel? Written, produced, and performed by Falkner himself, both records showcased his remarkable ability to blend sophisticated songwriting, inventive arrangements, and flawless musicianship. Decades later, they remain touchstones for fans and fellow musicians alike. Omnivore Recordings is proud to celebrate the 30th anniversary of Falkner’s landmark debut, Presents Author Unknown. For this special edition, Falkner returned to the original multitrack tapes to create an all-new remix, revealing greater depth, punch, and sonic detail while remaining faithful to the spirit of the original release. Side 4 of this double album contain the outtake “My Home Is Not A House” and three 4-track demos of songs from the album. Pressed on opaque red and green vinyl, this deluxe anniversary edition also features extensive new liner notes from Falkner, reflecting on the album’s enduring significance and the creative motivations behind revisiting and remixing the record three decades later. Thirty years after its original release, Presents Author Unknown remains a shining example of timeless songwriting and fearless musical craftsmanship. This new remix not only reaffirms the album’s lasting brilliance—it reminds us why Jason Falkner continues to be regarded as a musician’s musician, an artist whose creativity, vision, and passion remain as vital as ever.

title: El Inicio

description:
Before Ruben Blades became one of the most influential voices in Latin music, he was shaping his artistic identity in Panama through a series of rare and largely unknown recordings that remained hidden from most fans, collectors, and even longtime followers for decades. El Inicio brings together, for the first time ever, ten early recordings from the late 1960s featuring Ruben as vocalist with Los Salvajes del Ritmo, Nacho Molino y su Conjunto, and Orquesta Dimeños — years before New York, Fania, and the global recognition that would change salsa forever.

These recordings capture the foundation of the storytelling, urban narrative, genre fusion, and social perspective that would later redefine Latin music through his groundbreaking work with Fania and Seis del Solar. Moving between boleros, guarachas, and guaguancos, the collection also reveals a little-known side of Ruben Blades as a powerful sonero and romantic vocalist, offering collectors and fans an unprecedented look into the formative years of a musical visionary.

Pressed on 160g colored vinyl, El Inicio features fully restored and remastered audio by Frank Merritt at London’s legendary The Carvery Studio, alongside brand-new artwork built around a never-before-used archival photograph of Ruben Blades. More than a compilation, this is a historic archival release — the missing first chapter in the story of one of salsa’s greatest innovators.

description: Studio One Dub 2 brings together some of the finest dubs from the legendary Studio One Records, Kingston, Jamaica. Dub music was the creation of a generation of brilliant recording studio engineers in Jamaica. Throughout the 1970s, these mixes became more sophisticated and atmospheric. The cuts here demonstrate that Studio One's contribution to the innovative musical form of dub was substantial and go straight to the head of listeners who feel that the only centers for dub were studios such as King Tubby's, Lee Perry's Black Ark, Channel One, or Joe Gibbs’. The tracks on this compilation are taken from this period in the 1970s when dub was the cutting-edge of Jamaican music studio production. Most of them are the dub-version flip-sides of rare Jamaican 45s. Sleevenotes are by Michael E. Veal, celebrated author of Dub: Soundscapes and Shattered Songs in Jamaican Reggae. New one-off pressing sky-blue double vinyl limited-edition for RSD Black Friday. Out of print for over 10 years. First ever color vinyl edition. "Dub is the music of the studio engineers and the sound-system rulers. Studio One Dub cannot help but to serve as loving tribute to this giant of a man who not only defined popular music for the isle of Jamaica, but for the world over, his innovations laying the foundations for hip-hop, dance and post-rock."-- Pitchfork "Soul Jazz unearths a new bag of lost, rare, and essential dub gems from Jamaican cornerstone label Studio One. A fresh taste of timeless music.” --XLR8R

title: Passover XX
label: The Reverberation Appreciation Society
description: Twenty years after its original release, Passover has been re-recorded and reimagined through the lens of two decades of growth - as a band, as musicians, and as people. These songs have lived many lives since 2006. Shaped across thousands of performances around the world, each track has evolved into a living, breathing organism - changing subtly night after night, year after year. These new recordings document that evolution. Working alongside producer Dave Sardy (Oasis, LCD Soundsystem, Modest Mouse), The Black Angels returned to Passover not to recreate it, but to fully realize what the songs have become twenty years later. The result is a heavier, deeper, and more expansive recording: bigger riffs, richer textures, deeper low end, and a renewed sense of atmosphere and intensity that reflects the band as they exist today - while preserving every ounce of the raw power and spirit that defined the original album. Originally written and recorded during the Iraq War, the themes and message behind Passover feel more urgent and relevant now than ever before. Two decades later, these songs still speak to cycles of violence, disillusionment, resistance, and humanity’s ongoing struggle against oppression - a reminder that history continues to repeat itself. This is not a nostalgia piece. It’s Passover transformed by twenty years of experience, perspective, and sound.

title: Live in NYC 1996 - 2006
label: Real Gone Music
description:
No guitarist sounds like the late, great Tom Verlaine. His career-long pursuit of the perfect, effect-free guitar tone set him apart from his peers right off the bat; combine that with his vaunted vibrato technique, self-taught, free jazz-influenced sensibility, and the slow burn and build architecture of his solos, and there really is no mistaking his fretwork for anybody else’s. Verlaine’s singular instrumental and songwriting prowess certainly came through on his studio recordings, both with Television and solo. But it was in live settings that his improvisational genius really shined. Fortunately for us, it turns out, as one might expect from an artist whose interests ranged widely from literature and modern art to music, that Tom was something of a collector. Therefore, we at Real Gone Music are truly thrilled to present the first of what we hope will be a series of release from his extensive archives: a double-LP collection of COMPLETELY UNRELEASED live performances drawn from four different New York shows spanning the years of 1996 to 2006. Along the way you’ll hear songs taken from his solo albums ranging from his first self-titled release to The Wonder, Flash Light, Words from the Front, Around, and Songs and Other Things, plus three songs new to his discography. Compiled and mastered by Verlaine’s long-time engineer and band-mate Patrick Derivaz, with artwork contributions by his partner, the artist Jutta Koether, and liner notes by Derivaz, Koether, David Fricke, Jimmy Rip, David Licht, and Tony Shanahan, Live NYC 96-06 is a key contribution to the Tom Verlaine catalog and an absolute must for his fans and guitar heads alike.

Before dominating the Grammys and defining the sound of modern R&B, Victoria Monét delivered two of her most intimate, foundational projects: Life After Love, Pt. 1 and Life After Love, Pt. 2. Released individually in 2018, these twin EPs capture a pivotal chapter in Monét’s evolution as a solo artist, establishing the lush vocal arrangements, cinematic production, and razor-sharp songwriting that would later captivate the world. Now, for the first time ever, both transformative projects are combined into a single physical release, debuting exclusively on vinyl for RSD Black Friday 2026.

The dual project charts a complete emotional arc, chronicling the delicate journey from heartbreak to self-actualization. Part 1 delves into the raw vulnerability and quiet introspection of a breakup’s immediate fallout, anchored by sultry, unfiltered anthems like "Freak." Part 2 turns the page toward rediscovery, blooming into an exploration of newfound confidence and sensuality through standout cuts like "New Love" and the shimmering, bass-heavy fan favorite "Ass Like That." Seamlessly bridging pain and empowerment across its tracklist, the combined collection showcases Monét's innate ability to translate personal grief into universal, groove-heavy solace.

By pressing these two landmark EPs together on wax, this release offers long-time fans and vinyl collectors the ultimate way to experience Monét's early masterwork as a unified narrative. It stands as a long-overdue physical grail, celebrating the resilient spirit of an artist taking back her narrative—and serving as a reminder that the best music often blooms from the ashes of heartache.

1xLP, pressed on Brown & Tan Galaxy vinyl and limited to 2000 units worldwide.

title: A Charlie Brown Christmas (Advent Calendar Edition)
label: Craft Recordings
description: The beloved holiday album and best-selling jazz album of all time, Vince Guaraldi Trio’s A Charlie Brown Christmas, is now available in this limited Advent Calendar edition on eco-mix red vinyl for Record Store Day Black Friday. Housed in a gatefold jacket featuring 24 openable windows, each revealing a different design from the PEANUTS holiday special. This perennial classic continues to introduce generations of children and adults to the joys of jazz through holiday favorites including “Christmas Time is Here,” “O Tannenbaum,” “Skating,” and “Linus and Lucy.”

title: Konnakol (Deluxe Edition)
label: Mercury/Republic
description: KONNAKOL is ZAYN’s fifth studio album and his most culturally inspired project to date, expanding on the pop-forward sound fans first heard on his record-breaking debut, Mind of Mine. KONNAKOL, in its definition, is the act of creating percussive sounds with one’s voice, but what it means to ZAYN lies deeper, drawing inspiration from his own heritage. This 18-track Deluxe Edition is pressed for RSD Black Friday on special, limited-edition Concrete Jungle colored vinyl.
